notes: This is the Rates Act that gave effect to the 2025 Budget (Bill B14-2025). Schedule I paragraph 1 rates apply to natural persons for years of assessment commencing on or after 1 March 2025. This Act does not amend the rebates in s 6 of the Income Tax Act (its only Income Tax Act amendment is to s 13quat), so the primary, secondary and tertiary rebates, and the tax thresholds that follow from them, must be read from the consolidated Income Tax Act, which is NOT deposited.
